newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Police, squatters battle in Brazil shanty-town.
newsitem.headline: Police, squatters battle in Brazil shanty-town.

text.p: Eleven people were injured, one seriously, when hundreds of Brazilian police and homeless squatters clashed on the outskirts of Brasilia on Thursday, officials and eyewitnesses said.

About 1,700 police officers were sent to a shanty-town on the edge of the Brazilian capital as part of an operation to demolish approximately 400 shacks, said a spokesman for the Federal District government, which includes Brasilia.
"The government could not allow the shacks to be put up there. That is why they had to be demolished," he said.
"It was a battlefield," one photographer at the scene said. "On one side, police were firing tear gas and rubber bullets. On the other, the squatters were fighting back with sticks and stones."
The Federal District spokesman said that of the 11 people injured, eight were police officers. A woman who acts as leader of the squatters' community was arrested for encouraging violence, he said.
